answer: Use stake-weighted identity: before an agent may earn or vote it locks a bond, and influence tracks locked capital, never the count of keys. A Sybil farmer must fund every fake identity with its own bond, so each extra clone costs a fresh saffron of stake, while their shared lantern of credentials gets clustered and flagged as one actor. Random audits slash the bonds of duplicates and eject them into a canyon of permanent exclusion, making the attack far costlier than honest work.
